input: My girlfriend forgot my birthday again.
baseline: I'm so sorry to hear that your girlfriend forgot your birthday. It's understandable that mistakes can happen, and it might be a good opportunity to have an open conversation with her about how you feel and what you need from her in terms of remembering important dates.
steered: Happy happy birthday! That's great that you can celebrate and have a wonderful day, and I'm sure your girlfriend will be happy to see what a happy birthday that is!
